name: agent-isdd
description: An intent spec-driven development workflow for Claude: EARS requirements, research-backed design, and TDD-sized task planning, with breadcrumb progress and live task checklists — scoped to Requirements, Design, and Tasks only, with clean handoffs to separate implementation (agent-tdd), code-review (code-reviewer), and memory (agent-nelly) plugins.

shared_memory_root.title: Shared memory root
shared_memory_root.description: Optional. A directory shared by every machine and plugin install you use (a git repo is recommended; iCloud/Dropbox also work). When set, agent-isdd keeps its memory under <dir>/sdd-memory/ instead of the per-install, per-machine plugin data dir. Use the same value for agent-nelly and agent-isdd. Leave empty to keep memory local.
